purpose: Whole-project clean rebuild of the Lean project of release v1.18.0 (adds Paper 11).
result: 3005 of 3005 modules compiled; 3004 of 3005 replayed with leanchecker; the module Research has no constants and was exempted; 0 audit problems.
computer: the author's Windows computer (63 GB of memory, 16 logical CPUs)
procedure: New empty output directory; sources copied from the release tree lean/ (Research.lean and Research/, 3007 files, of which 3005 are Lean modules). After the build their SHA-256 hashes were compared with the release tree: no difference. The directory Comparator/ was not built here; it is unchanged since version 1.13.0, and the CI workflow checks it.
Each module compiled with lean -DautoImplicit=false -DrelaxedAutoImplicit=false, then each module replayed with leanchecker, by the driver build6.py of version 1.16.0. This is not a lake build.
Warnings are recorded and do not fail a module; an error, sorry or non-zero exit code does.
In the published logs the local workspace directory is replaced by <workspace>; the toolchain directory does not occur in them; nothing else is changed.

runs.note: One run, up to 12 jobs. Compile phase until 06:54:33Z, leanchecker phase after it. Every module passed at the first attempt; no log has the suffix .attemptN. Final status: status.json; the file DONE records the end. The start time is that of the first module; the driver was launched about a second earlier.

module_Research.how_counted: readModuleData on Research.olean (research-olean-constants.txt in the log archive)
module_Research.consequence: leanchecker has nothing to replay in this module. It was exempted before the run, as for versions 1.15.0 to 1.17.0.

warnings: 97 lines in 15 older modules, the same modules as for version 1.17.0; none in Paper 11.
axioms: every printed axiom list is a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The 7 lists printed by Research.CographDist.Audit are each exactly these three axioms.
forbidden_tokens: logs/clean-replay-v1.18.0-forbidden-tokens.log: outside comments, only the intentional sorry statements of the comparator challenge files lean/Comparator/.
